verdict.rationale: Sunbiz's published pages document online filing for LLC and corporation articles and an online annual report. The annual-report flow points users to an identifier-based entry: refer to your notice or search records by name, and a tracking number is used to reprint a voucher. Credit or debit card payment is offered as an alternative to a prepaid Sunbiz E-File Account, which implies no account is required, but no page states this outright. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the formation and annual-report flows start without account creation, an explicitly documented document-number entry step, and hands-on corroboration of the keyless path.
